summary_1line: Narayana reveals to Markandeya that he is the supreme source, creator, sustainer, and destroyer of the universe who incarnates to restore cosmic order.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant divine child reveals his cosmic form, declaring the sun and moon as his eyes and the earth as his feet before the astonished sage Markandeya.
Vishnu as a colossal boar lifts the drowned earth from the dark cosmic waters.
The universe appears as the body of Narayana, with stars as pores of his skin and oceans as his robes.
